description: This file defines a Java interface 'DigitalProductDao' which extends generic DAO operations for DigitalProduct entities and includes a method to retrieve a digital product by merchant store and product.

classes.name: DigitalProductDao
classes.description: A Java interface extending generic DAO for DigitalProduct with a method to get a DigitalProduct by MerchantStore and Product.

methods.name: getByProduct
